main_idea: Distillation lifts GDPval net win-loss margin about 21% in two model families
ideas: Distillation improves GDPval performance in Nemotron and Qwen
Student learns from teacher scoring its own rollouts
Net win-loss margin vs base: +20.9% and +21.4%
Mean rubric score gains of 5.1 and 7.9 points
summary: Clutter is the slogan headline, eyebrow tags, subtitle and the method diagram plus mean-score row, which pull attention from the two net win-loss margins. Nothing essential is missing and no rendering defects are visible.
